title: Say Pasyente
intro: Abayag lan panaon, nen sankaunaan iran agew na awaran na too, duaran kamarerwa so inmalagey ed arap na Manamalsa ra a walaan na saray bagat. Sakey so inawat, sakey so andi. Say tinmumbok et nagmaliw ya sankaunaan ya baleg a trahedya ed baetan na sanaagi - sakey a gawa na maanos ya panag-amper tan sakey a gawa na mapait a panagbales. Sarag mon naamtaan no siopa ak?
clues: Nianak ak nen inmunan agew na inkiwala na too diad dalin
Anak ak na sankaunaan ya paris na totoon nambilay ed sayan dalin
Aminsan et angiyapay ak na bagat manlapud sankaabigan ed pulok ko pian napaliket so Manamalsak
Say apay ko et inawat manlapud tagey, bangta say apay nen agik et ag inawat
Nen tinaktakot da ak ya pateyen, pinilik ya ag-itagey so limak ed agik
Siak so nagmaliw ya sankaunaan a too ed interon awaran na too ya lingon pinatey na sananey

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Habil (Abel), ya anak nen Adan
Qabil (Cain), ya anak nen Adan
Si Adan, say inmunan too
Nuh (Noah)
Ibrahim (Abraham)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say sankaunaan ya impamatey ed awaran na too
Say baleg a delap na Nuh
Say inkaderal na armada nen Fir'awn
Say bagat nen Ismail nen Ibrahim
Say bakal sumpad Jalut (Goliath)
trial.answer: Say sankaunaan ya impamatey ed awaran na too

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a karnero ya inyapay bilang makapaliket a bagat
Sakey a baleg a biong a gawad kiew
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a manok ya hoopoe ya walay awit ton mensahe na ari
Sakey a manliob a kanal na apoy
location.answer: Sakey a karnero ya inyapay bilang makapaliket a bagat

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nagmaliw ya sankaunaan ya biktima na panagpatey ed awaran na too
Akaliktar ed baleg a delap diad loob na sakey a bapor a gawad kiew
Manaayam ed loob na eges na baleg a sira
Inuleyan to ray jinn, totoo, tan say dagem
Nanakar-akar ed loob na apataplon taon ed malaknab a kalawakan
outcome.answer: Nagmaliw ya sankaunaan ya biktima na panagpatey ed awaran na too

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
